about.title: Who I am
about.body: Brazilian front-end engineer from Belo Horizonte, with a playful side that makes art by hand.
about.homeIntro: Hi, I'm {name}. A Brazilian who plays with life and art. This shop is that lighter side: making things by hand, just for the joy of it.
about.intro: I'm {age}, Brazilian, from Belo Horizonte. Professionally I'm a front-end software engineer. You can find that side of me at {portfolio}.
paragraphs: This space, the prints and the handmade pieces, is more of a playful way to live. Not a second career, just curiosity and craft.
Over the years I've made authored works in different forms, taken part in theatre workshops at Pena Escola Arena, and stayed curious about social sciences and cultural production.
I like learning and exploring what life puts in front of me. I have my own way of seeing the world, and sometimes that ends up on paper.
about.contact: Prefer a direct conversation? Message me on WhatsApp. I reply personally.
